pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (order of evaluation and exponentiation exceptions, which apply 'regardless of the mode of arithmetic'), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 ('with a precision of 32 decimal digits') and §2002:8.8.1.3.2 (each sum 'truncated to 32 significant digits'), and §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation); this text governs only under ARITHMETIC IS STANDARD (§2002:8.8.1.3), and the compiler keeps 34 digits there at --std 2002 (PB5575, reconfirmed by probes-a-21/src/vals.cob: (B*100 + 1) - B*100 gives 1 where 2002 gives 0). Read §2002:14.6.4 (size error condition) and §2002:14.6.6 (arithmetic statements: composite of operands, standard intermediate data item, storing order). GR8 decides which occurrence of the sum counter receives each occurrence of a repeating addend (§2002:13.16.52.3 GR8). The addition itself is 'consistent with the general rules of the ADD statement with the ON SIZE ERROR phrase' (§2002:13.16.52.3 GR3), so size error and precision belong to GR3/GR4 and 14.6.4; the mapping does not depend on them. The witnesses use small native values.
